fields.origin_detail: 27 columns (name, price, currency_code, out_of_stock, section, category, offer, discounted_price, field_json_data … legacy_id) created in 000_baseline and net03_full_schema
fields.means: The pre-item_data price-list table.
fields.set_by: nobody (no INSERT/UPDATE in lib, routes, scripts)
fields.finding: ARCHIVED 2026-08-06 (src/routes/catalogue.js: routes removed, "tables are empty", left dormant "for a cycle", then "drop them in a gated migration"). Only src/services/catalogue.js (unreferenced), jest.setup.js (truncate) and the schema files name it. PROPOSE: retire — a migration drops cb_catalogue_item and cb_catalogue_category after the survey shows 0 rows (copy kept in the migration; Athi runs it). If a price_type/offer model is wanted later it belongs on the price overlay, not here.
